Name the part of a tree that grows underground. The quiet village of Greenlake is rocked when its beloved statue goes missing, and amateur detective Lily decides to take the case. She stumbles upon a series of clues that reveal the deep-seated rivalries among some of the village's most influential figures. The climax occurs during the annual festival, where Lily exposes the thief and the motives in a dramatic confrontation. The statue's recovery leads to the village healing old wounds and Lily earning respect as a true detective.
</parameter>
